sections.text: Introduction

This 
procedure details the steps required to completely checl the proper operation of 
the micromho distance relay. It is recommended this procedure be carried out on 
a yearly bases

The 
document is formatted the way to minimize the possibility of error causing 
personal injury or damage to equipment

The first draft initiated by Mostafa Ibraheem and tested by 
 eng Abd Elnaseer Mostafa 
 , 
 accepted by general manager eng Shoaqi Mahmod, approved by eng Mohamed Mahdy 
 Rezk.
Safety Precautions

Make sure CT secondary circuits are shorted before isolating the relay current 
 circuits for current injection

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding 
 the work area is required.

Safety 
 and Healthy equipment must be used 
 (safety Helmet, safety shoes, ...etc).

Make sure CT secondary circuits are shorted before isolating the relay current 
 circuits for current injection

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items:
TZ 2 test set this test set consists of 2 units supply, timer 
 and volt injection unit and current injection unit
Multimeters
Test plug (MMLG 01)
Test leads
Screwdriver

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Preliminary steps to 
prepare for relay testing

items: This procedure is used to perform off load relay test
Obtain copy of relay setting from field maintenance file
Obtain outage for line protected by this relay
Check that the bus and line disconnect switches are opened and tagged

Inspect the CT secondary circuits, the VT miniature circuit breakers (MCB`s) 
 and all cabling supplying the relay
Use station drawing to isolate
Disturbance alarms and fault recorder associated with this relay
Auto - re-close associated with this relay

sections.text:
Testing the relay, relay 
scheme, and protection outputs

items: Carefully follow these test procedure steps

Verify the test results match the relay setting, if not consult technical 
 services
Test trip all breakers associated with the relay

sections.text:
Prior to starting testing 
procedure (s) ensure the following steps

items:
Look at the EEA panel nameplate and check that this EEA system designation 
 nameplate agrees with the line that has been taken out of service for 
 maintenance
Check there is no AC current from CT`s by using A clip on ammeter
Check there is no AC voltage from VT`s by using A voltmeter

sections.text: Preparation

items:
Ensure that the CT secondary are correctly short circuited on the case 
 side of test plug
These connections must be made before the test plug is inserted

Connect the current terminals IA, IB, IC and IN and the voltage terminals 
 VA, VB, VC, and VN on the test plug to the corresponding current and voltage 
 terminals on the supply unit test set
Insert the test plug
Adjust the test unit switches as
Put the angle switch at -90
Ampere switch on 3A

The injection direction switch on normal position in case of forward zones 
 Z1, Z2, Z4 and on reverse position in case of reverse zone Z3
Put the injection type switch on I + Vp

sections.text: Testing the phase to ground and phase to phase measuring elements

items:
Select phase to ground fault A-N by using relay selector switch on supply 
 unit test set
Connect the outgoing voltage from the supply unit
Switch on the injection switch
Start the test by pressing the switch on the control unit momentarily
Observe that the red indications A,N and Z1 on the relay will light up

Change the value of the potential tap up or down until the relay operates
 In second step (the red indication Z2 on the relay will light up with the last 
 indication)
Record this pickup points on test sheet

sections.text:
Repeat the above test for 
phases B-N, C-N, A-B, B-C and C-A

items:
Repeat the above test but this time calculate potential corresponding to 
 the relay setting of the second zone for phase to ground and phase to phase 
 fault set this value on the test set and then change it up or down until the 
 relay operates in third step
Switch off switch

sections.text:
Measuring the operating 
times

items: Set potential switch to 50 % of the zone 1 reach

Select phase to phase fault A-B by using relay selector switch on supply 
 unit test set

Connect test leads between timer contact on the relay to the stop terminal 
 of the timer
Reset the interval timer
Switch on
Start the test by pressing switch on
The timer will stop once the relay has picked up
Record the zone 1 tripping time on test sheet
Repeat tests for zone 2 and zone 3 operating times
Repeat tests for phase to ground operating times

sections.text: Switch on to fault (sotf)

items: Inject current only and disconnect the voltage terminal
The indication led for (sotf) light up

sections.text:
Voltage transformer 
supervision

items: Inject current and volt
Disconnect voltage terminal
The indication led for (V - fail) light up

sections.text:
Testing the relay, relay 
scheme, and protection outputs

items:
Verify the test results match the relay setting if not consult technical 
 services

Perform check of the acceleration of the relay, breaker failure and 
 reclosure schemes, separate technical procedures should be used to test each 
 of these systems
Test trip all breakers associated with the relay

sections.text:
Return relay and 
associated equipment to service

items: Return relay to service by withdrawing the test plug handle from the relay

If any equipment associated with the relay has been isolated without the 
 test plug it should be returned to service by the following restoration steps
Disturbance alarms and fault recorder associated with this relay
Auto - reclosure associated with this relay

sections.text:
Request power line be 
returned to service

items:
Take crossed readings of all AC currents and voltages supplied to the 
 relay and compare then to those for normal load conditions

Check that readings agree with station meters
 (MW / MVAR / power factor / amperes / voltages)
Place a copy of the test result in the field maintenance files
